## Aeetos (CR 5)

This bull-like creature seems to be made of interlocking metallic scales and plates, with glowing embers for eyes and smoke trailing up from its mouth.  

**XP** 1,600  
N Large magical beast (fire)  
**Init** +0; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +9; **Aura** forge heat (5 ft., 1d6 fire)  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 9, flat-footed 17 (+8 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 70 (5d10+20)  
**Fort** +9, **Ref** +4, **Will** +4  
**Immune** fire; Weaknesses vulnerable to cold  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** gore +10 (2d8+5), 2 hooves +4 (1d6+2)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (30-foot cone, 5d6 fire, DC 17, usable every 1d4 rounds), burning stampede, trample (1d6+7 plus 1d6 fire, DC 17)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 21, **Dex** 11, **Con** 20, **Int** 2, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 5  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +11 (+13 bull rush); **CMD** 21 (23 vs. bull rush, 25 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Improved Bull Rush, Iron Will, [Weapon Focus (gore)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (gore).*  
**Skills** Perception +9  


**Special Abilities**



**Burning Stampede (Su)** When an aeetos uses its trample ability, all squares it passes through burst into flame as it moves. These flames persist until the beginning of the aeetos’ next turn and then go out. Creatures entering or beginning their turn in the burning area take 1d6 points of fire damage.
